key_events_next_24h.name: Weekend low-liquidity session (Sat-Sun, no major US macro releases)
Goldman Sachs BTC ETF approval decision pending

market_summary.trend: BTC ~$63,017 as of 07:30 UTC Aug 1 (Saturday). Down ~3.23% in 24h. Price in descending channel, rejected near upper boundary ($65,000). Fear & Greed Index at 30 (Fear zone). August historically the worst BTC month (-7.87% median, red 2022-2025).
market_summary.sentiment: Bearish lean. Fear & Greed at 30. ETF inflows down 83% from July peak ($197M to $33M in 2 weeks). Whale buyers emerged Jul 23 but insufficient to reverse trend. Mid-tier holders continuing to sell. Strategy reported $8.22B net Q2 loss on BTC holdings.
market_summary.macro: FOMC concluded Jul 28-29: rates held at 3.50-3.75% (3 hawkish dissenters). Next FOMC: Sep 15-16. Today is Saturday — no US economic releases. Key upcoming: ISM PMI Aug 3 (Monday), NFP Aug 7 (Friday), CPI Aug 12 (Wednesday). Goldman Sachs spot BTC ETF decision still pending (Aug 21 est). SEC delayed Truth Social BTC ETF to Sep 18.
market_summary.macro_regime: Rates-sensitive environment. BTC correlated with risk assets. Hawkish Fed tone (3 dissenters at Jul FOMC) applying pressure. Weekend session = lower liquidity = elevated volatility risk. August seasonal headwinds.
market_summary.nfp_watch: Next major catalyst: NFP Aug 7 at 12:30 UTC. Strong jobs = hawkish pressure bearish for BTC. Weak jobs = dovish pivot bets bullish for BTC. Current Fed rate: 3.50-3.75%.
